item.title: Costco releases Nike collaboration; coveted shoes quickly pop up on resell sites
item.description: Costco and Nike have sparked quite the frenzy with a new sneaker collaboration.

item.title: Cold front passes wet Tuesday evening
item.description: We'll be hitting the 70s multiple times this week, but there is a brief interruption from a rainy cold front blowing in late Tuesday.

item.title: Clintons try to reach agreement for Epstein testimony before contempt of Congress vote
item.description: The House is headed towards potential votes this week on criminal contempt of Congress charges against the Clintons.

item.title: Man convicted, sentenced to 50 years for violent family assault, Montgomery County officials say
item.description: According to Montgomery County officials, the victim was rushed to the hospital for multiple stab wounds and fractures. The victim's husband was later found guilty of violent family assault and sentenced to 50 years in prison, officials said.

item.title: Federal government orders Houston housing officials to fix city's affordable housing program
item.description: The federal government has ordered Houston housing officials to explain how they plan to fix the city's affordable housing program.

item.title: Jasmine Crockett, James Talarico vie for Democratic Senate nomination for U.S. Senate
item.description: Both spoke with ABC13 about the primary and the challenges they face campaigning in a large state.

item.title: Child unharmed after deputies find man dead, woman hurt after shooting at NW Houston apartment: HCSO
item.description: Sheriff Ed Gonzalez said the victims were in a relationship, and the man was reportedly upset that the woman was planning to leave him.

item.title: Houston police release new details about shooting that left 1 dead, 5 injured
item.description: The Houston Police Department is investigating the Saturday evening shooting on Homestead Road that left one person dead and five injured.

item.title: Uber driver beaten with rock and carjacked by 2 men in Montrose, police say
item.description: Two men are facing charges after police say they attacked an Uber driver with a rock before stealing her car.

item.title: Houston police SWAT officer killed after crashing city vehicle in NW Harris County, authorities say
item.description: Houston police identified the victim as Sean McCreary, a senior police officer who had been with the department since 2011. According to HPD, McCreary was off-duty but driving his city-issued take-home vehicle.
